releaseNotes:
v2.25.0 — Gameplay polish and Star Levels preview
• Fixed scroll position: grid now starts at top (or active row for resumed levels)
• Main menu now shows accurate guess counts per difficulty
• Added Star Levels section (Coming Soon — unlock with stars in Adventure)
• Life now only deducted if you submit at least one guess on a level
• Fixed 'Level N' badge splitting mid-word — now shows as 'Lv. N'
• Added tests for onExitLevel life refund behavior and difficulty parameters
